messages:
maria: Heads-up — customer reported non-admins with 'billing-viewer' role could pull org-level usage and cost reports. They found it via GET /v1/orgs/<org>/usage.

maria: Repro steps: 1) login as billing-viewer 2) GET /v1/orgs/rc-123/usage?from=2026-03-01 3) response included other projects' costs. :eyes:

aj: that's bad. which account? any audit log entries?

maria: traced to terry@acme.com. token used by billing-service-worker. audit shows a 200 with body containing cross-project rows, but no structured audit fields for scope.

devin: sounds like an RBAC scope mismatch — policy rule likely allows org.* or global usage read instead of scoping to org/project.

samir: can you paste the policy that matched?

maria: ```json
{
  "role": "billing-viewer",
  "permissions": ["read:usage","read:quota"],
  "resource": "org.*"
}
```

linda: yeah org.* is way too broad. should be explicit: org:{org_id} or project-scoped resource patterns. also check UI: download CSV/button might be leaking aggregated org view.

aj: priority mitigation: block billing-viewer from calling admin/usage endpoints until we patch. @ops-bot can we add a temporary deny at the gateway?

ops-bot: Temporary deny rule applied to route /v1/orgs/*/usage for role billing-viewer. Rule id: deny-1792003456, expires_in: 60m. :white_check_mark:

devin: I'll open PR to change RBAC matcher to require resource pattern `org:{org_id}:usage` and add middleware enforcement. PR will include unit + integration tests for scope enforcement.

samir: add an explicit audit event 'usage.query' with fields caller_role and request_scope. Also verify audit logs are encrypted using our CMK (KMS) and retention set to 180d for compliance.

linda: keep in mind Dedicated/Private deployments may have custom RBAC mapping. add feature flag `rbac-strict-scope` default off for Private customers until we validate.

aj: timeline?

devin: PR in ~30m, request review from @samir and @linda. hotfix to prod after canary in ~2h. will include migration script to tighten existing policies (map org.* -> org:{org_id} where possible).

maria: created incident ticket INC-2026-452 and notifying affected customers. Support team looped in for remediation guidance.

security-bot: Incident created INC-2026-452, severity: high, pager: oncall. :rotating_light:

maria: followups assigned: - devin: PR + tests; - aj: gateway mitigation + scope-scan; - samir: audit events + KMS verification; - linda: customer impact + Private flag.

aj: running a quick scan for other roles with 'org.*' resource patterns. will post results.

aj: scan results: analytics-exporter, billing-viewer, quota-reporter — three hits. starting to patch the mappings.

maria: good. after hotfix we should run an automated scope-scan across policies and schedule a compliance review with Legal. keep everyone posted on rollouts.

linda: note for release notes: 'tightened RBAC scope for usage endpoints; added audit events; temporary deny applied for billing-viewer'.

maria: thanks — will draft customer-facing note once we confirm no impact to intended billing workflows.
